coreStats.name: Strength
coreStats.role: Physical power; brawn skills and physical combat; melee to-hit and damage. Lift limit = STR score x 15 lb.

coreStats.name: Intelligence
coreStats.role: Smarts; wit and knowledge skills; determines Mana at 1:1 with the INT score; most spells use INT to hit and damage.

coreStats.name: Constitution
coreStats.role: Toughness; stamina skills; determines Health (CON Mod per Health Bar slot) and the Dying countdown.

coreStats.name: Dexterity
coreStats.role: Agility; speed and nimbleness skills; drives Evade and ranged to-hit; PvP initiative.

coreStats.name: Charisma
coreStats.role: Presence; influence skills; attracting viewers and fans (Popularity).

degrees.attack: Roll twice as many base damage dice, then add your Stat Mod and other bonuses. Always hits.
degrees.evade: Evade the attack, and gain Advantage on your next Attack Action against that foe.
degrees.nonCombat: You achieve the best possible result.

degrees.attack: Deal bonus damage equal to the Floor Number.
degrees.evade: Evade the attack, and gain Advantage on your next Attack Action against that foe.
degrees.nonCombat: You did it quickly, quietly, and left no trace.

degrees.attack: Your attack hits; roll damage. No bonuses.
GM announces "Near Miss," encouraging allies to use an Intervene Action.
degrees.evade: You get hit (a Near Miss can be saved by an Intervene).

degrees.attack: You miss badly - drop an item, need to reload, or suffer the Take Down Debuff.
degrees.evade: Take additional damage equal to the Floor Number and gain a Minor Injury after combat.
degrees.nonCombat: Fail with a real consequence; you cannot retry that skill this scene.

degrees.attack: The worst outcome - hit an ally, break a weapon, gain a Debuff. Always misses.
degrees.evade: Take twice as much damage and gain a Major Injury after combat.
